What makes a good casino a great one?

Withdrawing your money quickly and securely is a key part of our 25-step reviews process we cover when reviewing a casino. When you wager your hard-earned cash, it’s important to know that a casino will payout when they say they will. With years of experience reviewing online casinos, we only recommend reputable sites that give clear payout timeframes.Here’s some of the things we look for when we rate casinos:

  • Payout speed

    For a casino to be classed as offering fast-payouts we expect to see withdrawal speed options of 1-3 days or less. Instant withdrawals are becoming increasingly available for players betting with cryptocurrency, and are naturally a popular option. Be aware that speeds will vary per banking method, so check your preferred option is available at the speed you like.

  • Safety & licensing

    A fast payout is no good if your transactions aren’t secure and the casino is unlicensed. We expect casinos to have SSL encryption software to ensure your personal details are safe and that they hold trusted licenses for the markets they operate in.

  • Welcome bonuses

    New players should expect to see excellent sign-up bonuses on offer from the best online casinos. We look behind the impressive numbers to check the wagering requirements of the offers as this is where players can be caught out. We like to see wagering requirements lower than 30x and with a reasonable timeframe to complete them, typically 2 weeks or more.

  • Payment options

    We check casinos offer popular payment methods not only as this benefits players, but it also signals the trustworthiness of the casino. When you’re looking for fast payouts, you’ll tend to see options like cryptocurrencies and e-wallets offering the best speeds.

  • Customer care

    Top casinos will offer players customer support options that are fast and responsive. We rate options like 24/7 live chat and helplines higher than typically slower options like help forms and postal support. We also expect to see a fully fleshed out FAQs section to help players bypass the need for further help.

Fastest payout banking options

All online gamblers want their winnings fast and with ease, whether you’re an avid slots player or a roulette enthusiast. How fast a payout is made is largely down to the online casino, but also the payment method you use to deposit and withdraw.

Here are some of the fastest withdrawal banking methods available to online casino players:

PayPal
PayPal
PayPal is an extremely secure payment method that is accepted by some of the biggest online casinos. PayPal is only accepted for casino deposits in a few countries such as Canada.
PaysafeCard
PaysafeCard
PaysafeCard gives you online payment flexibility by allowing you to pay and receive money using a PIN number. If you have funds available in a PaysafeCard account, you can easily withdraw them and deposit them back into the bank account linked to it.
Skrill
Skrill
Skrill is a worldwide third party processor that works in the same realm as PayPal. The transfers show up immediately. Some of the best online casinos accept Skrill.
Neteller
Neteller
Several casinos accept Neteller, an eWallet that has attained a great reputation and is viewed favorably among online casino players and poker pros alike. It is not only fast but believed to have some of the lowest fees in the business.
eWallets
Electronic wallets are definitely growing in popularity and are one of the most convenient methods for fast payment withdrawals from the casino of choice. You can anticipate the turnaround to be very fast where you can plan on days instead of weeks.

FAQs

Do any online casinos actually pay out?

Yes, all legitimate casinos pay out if you win. Check out our shortlist of recommended fast withdrawal casinos to choose a casino that will pay out.

How are casino winnings withdrawn?

Casino winnings are withdrawn via a popular payment method accepted at that casino. You usually go to the casino cashier and request the withdrawal. Note that some casinos don't offer the same deposit options as they do for withdrawals. Find out how to get started at a fast payout casino here.

Do casino deposits and withdrawals use the same method?

Not always. Many casinos that accept credit cards for deposits will not allow credit cards to be used for withdrawing payouts. Check out the top methods for fast payouts on the page. It can be affected by which country you're in and the casino you're playing at.

What is the minimum withdrawal at casinos?

The minimum amount really depends upon two things: the casino and the payment method of withdrawal. Neteller will accept a withdrawal deposit into your account as low as € 10, however, your favorite fast withdrawal casinos may only approve your payouts if it is valued at a point that makes it worth their while.

Does withdrawal amount affect the timescale at casinos?

How long it will take to withdraw your winnings could depend on the amount. Again, it is super important to check with your online casino cashier prior to winning that huge jackpot, or possibly checking out just before you win it big. In most cases the really large withdrawals will be done in Check format. When that is the case you will typically not wait beyond ten days.

How can a casino with fewer payment options rate higher than a casino with more options?

It's quality over quantity. If it takes three weeks to process any one of a site's 10 payment methods, we're not impressed. But if it takes three days to get a Check into your hand, and if a cheque is the only option, we believe our players are better off.
